description: Defines an immutable 'Note' class with properties like id, title, body, isPinned, updatedAt, and createdAt. Includes methods for copying, serialization to a database-friendly format, and creating an instance from database row data.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: An immutable data class representing a note with properties for id, title, body, pin status, and timestamps. Provides methods for copying with modifications, converting to database format, and creating from database records.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Note with optional updated fields.

methods.name: toDb
methods.description: Serializes the Note to a Map suitable for database storage.

methods.name: fromDb
methods.description: Creates a Note instance from a database row represented as a Map.
